addingABrand.description: Steps to add a brand. The CLI (dart run bin/ckgoc.dart add brand "Acme", run inside a clone of the repo) does 1-4.
steps: Add a value to ckcoreBrand in lib/src/themes/ckcore_brand.dart and a case in its displayName switch
Export the brand files from lib/src/themes/themes.dart
Optional: set logos: const BrandLogos(master:, symbol:, name:, nav:) in both theme builders (defaults to BrandLogos.none)

colorUsage.warning: Always used for warnings, cautions, attention-needed states
colorUsage.info: Always used for informational messages, notices, hints
